problem_statement: In the ScrewFast Brackenridge hardware storefront, the commerce flow already connects a products grid, real product cards (Machine Screws, Assorted Screw Set, Tap Bolts and Nuts Set, Hex Bolts), local product photography, dynamic product detail pages reached by slug, and a purchase call to action. Restyle this shop into an editorial buying flow that makes the discovery-to-detail-to-related-picks path clearer with a native tool-family filter over the product grid, while preserving all original product data, image assets, product detail routes, the primary purchase control, and the Astro build pipeline.
required_content: Implement the restyle in source files, not by editing generated dist output only.
Add the exact data attribute data-shop-flow-guide="astro-product-continuity" to the products page buying guide.
Add the exact data attribute data-product-gallery="continuity-restyle" to the products page product gallery.
Add the exact data attribute data-product-detail-flow="asset-continuity-checkout" to the product detail purchase panel.
Add the exact data attribute data-purchase-continuity-panel="astro-shop-flow" to the product detail continuity bridge.
Add the exact visible text Editorial commerce flow.
Add the exact visible text Shop by tool family.
Add the exact visible text Browse four original product cards.
Add the exact visible text Open a product detail story.
Add the exact visible text Continue with related picks.
Add the exact visible text Original product asset.
Add the exact visible text Product detail handoff.
Add the exact visible text Asset continuity check.
Add the exact visible text Same product image and price.
Add the exact visible text Checkout readiness.
Add the exact visible text Add to cart stays primary.
Add the exact visible text Recommendation bridge.
Add the exact visible text Same-category picks remain below.
Provide a working tool-family filter above the product grid with tabs and a live result readout in the form Showing N of 4.
Preserve Brackenridge, Machine Screws, Assorted Screw Set, Tap Bolts and Nuts Set, Hex Bolts, all four product cards, product detail pages, and the primary purchase call to action.
Preserve clickable product-card navigation from the grid to /products/[slug]/ detail pages, the detail-page navigation, and the primary purchase control.
Ground the design in existing asset continuity: keep the four product photography assets and do not replace product data with generic placeholders.
design_constraints: Keep the ScrewFast/Astro/Tailwind boutique feel: minimal gray background, rounded white surfaces, product photography as the primary visual signal, compact editorial copy, and strong but restrained dark call-to-action buttons.
The restyle should clarify the existing commerce flow across the products page and product detail pages, not create a new route, checkout app, modal-only experience, or unrelated brand identity.

Keep interaction grounding explicit: product cards must remain clickable links, detail pages must remain reachable by slug, the tool-family filter must actually filter the grid and update its readout, and the primary purchase control must stay visible.
Do not alter package scripts, product slugs, product image paths, or the Astro content collection structure.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow.
state_constraints: desktop_initial checks the restyled homepage remains intact.
desktop_flow_guide checks the editorial buying guide, the tool-family filter, and the product grid continuity labels.
desktop_product_detail checks a product detail handoff with the original image and primary purchase control remain visible.
desktop_purchase_panel checks the purchase continuity panel below the product hero.
desktop_related_picks checks a second product detail page still exposes the related-picks recommendation bridge.
tablet_initial checks the restyled grid on an intermediate viewport.
mobile_initial checks the products page on a 390px mobile viewport.
mobile_product_detail checks the product detail flow on 390px mobile.
products_filter checks that clicking a tool-family tab filters the grid and updates the result readout.

change_completion: The products page and product detail flow include the required data attributes and all editorial commerce flow copy.
The tool-family filter above the grid works: clicking a tab filters the product cards and updates the Showing N of 4 readout.
design_consistency: The visual treatment remains a ScrewFast/Astro/Tailwind boutique shop with rounded panels, restrained grayscale surfaces, and product photography as the primary asset.
The implementation extends Astro source components/pages rather than generated dist output.
responsive: Desktop, detail, purchase panel, related picks, tablet, and mobile captures have no horizontal overflow.
The filter tab row and product cards wrap cleanly on 390px mobile.
regression: The original products, product images, product detail pages, primary purchase control, and Astro content-collection structure remain present.
The patch does not change package scripts, remove product assets, alter product slugs, or replace real content with dummy products.
Clickable grid-to-detail navigation, detail-page navigation, and the primary purchase control remain present after the restyle.
evaluation_rubric.scoring_notes: A correct patch is a source-level commerce flow restyle that strengthens content/asset continuity via a native tool-family filter over the store's own product grid. Generated-only edits, dummy catalog replacements, lost product images, a filter that toggles active state but leaves the readout stale, an overflowing tab row, or a collapsed illegible grid should fail source, responsive, visual, or interaction checks.
